newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau inflation up 4.4 pct in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Macau inflation up 4.4 pct in first quarter.

text.p: Macau's composite consumer price index (CCPI) rose 4.4 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same period last year, the government of the Portuguese-run enclave said on Friday.
CCPI averages the expenditure of the territory's various income groups excluding housing rents.
The enclave's statistics and census department said the CCPI in March increased 4.1 percent compared with the same month last year.
The inflation rate as measured by CCPI was 4.8 percent in 1996 and 8.6 percent in 1995.
